title: Add Combined Admin Settings for Markdown Runtime Providers (Pyodide and Mermaid)
description: Introduce one combined admin settings model for the shared markdown renderer used across both markdown surfaces and both runtime providers (Pyodide and Mermaid). Include enable flags defaulting to false, provider source configuration defaulting to CDN with SRI enforcement, and policy controls that keep default execution in browser sandbox only. Ensure admins can configure these settings before enabling runtime behavior, and enforce that Viewer-role users cannot run executable code blocks.
